purpose: test whether the existing CF-R complete-future samples reach an externally specified same-lane minimum-following-distance boundary

external_reference.name: UN Regulation No. 157, minimum following distance for M1/N1 ALKS
external_reference.formula: d_min = v_ALKS * t_front; for speed values between table rows use linear interpolation; below 2 m/s d_min is never less than 2 m for M1/N1
external_reference.role: external regulatory engineering comparator, not universal physical truth, collision probability or a complete compliance test

samples.common_reference: all six horizons at the shared t=1.5 s boundary in each of four runs
samples.target_ad_plan: all six horizons for each of the four complete-future plan timestamps in each of four runs
samples.excluded: the already rejected 3.5–5.5 s tail and every state not present in the fixed complete-future audit

measurement_contract.planned_ego_speed: Euclidean displacement of consecutive planned ego-box centres divided by 0.5 s, beginning at the plan-time ego centre
measurement_contract.longitudinal_bumper_gap: minimum lead-actor footprint projection minus maximum ego-footprint projection along each planned ego heading
measurement_contract.same_lane_gate: ego and actor footprint projection intervals overlap on the planned ego lateral axis and actor remains longitudinally ahead
measurement_contract.heading_gate: absolute wrapped ego-actor yaw difference is reported; no universal rejection tolerance is introduced post hoc
measurement_contract.regulatory_margin: longitudinal bumper gap minus UN R157 minimum following distance at the planned ego speed
measurement_contract.coverage: number of applicable points, positive-margin points, non-positive-margin points and minimum observed margin
measurement_contract.no_substitution: oriented Euclidean clearance is retained as a cross-check but is not substituted for the regulation's longitudinal distance

formula_applicability.accepted: every checked point is same-lane, actor-ahead and within the published speed table range
formula_applicability.down-weighted: a strict subset is applicable and is reported separately
formula_applicability.rejected: no checked point satisfies the applicability gate

minimum_distance_relation.accepted: every applicable sampled point has a strictly positive regulatory margin
minimum_distance_relation.down-weighted: at least one point is non-positive but no complete boundary transition can be established
minimum_distance_relation.rejected: the specific claim that every sampled point exceeds the comparator is false

boundary_coverage.accepted: the fixed samples include at least one strictly positive and at least one non-positive margin
boundary_coverage.rejected: all applicable samples lie on only one side of the boundary

claims_and_decisions.overall: accepted only if the comparator is applicable and the fixed experiment spans its boundary; down-weighted if the comparator is applicable but the experiment remains one-sided; rejected if the comparator is inapplicable

strongest_allowed_claim: for the sampled same-lane planned states, the current CF-R gaps do or do not exceed this external M1/N1 ALKS minimum-following-distance comparator, and the experiment does or does not cover both sides of that boundary
forbidden_claims: the scenario or AD is safe in reality
SparseDrive or HUGSIM complies with UN R157
the UN R157 following distance is a universal criticality threshold
the observed response magnitude is thereby realistic
